title: US plans livestream of execution by firing squad
summary: The US plans to livestream the December 3rd execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan by firing squad, marking an unusual public announcement of a federal execution. Major social media platforms have not yet confirmed whether they will allow the livestream.
content:
The United States' execution of the Fort Hood shooter will be livestreamed, anonymous officials from the Defense Department told the BBC and Associated Press. The planned execution of Nidal Hasan, the former US Army major convicted of killing 13 people at the Texas military base, was announced this week. He is scheduled to be executed by firing squad on December 3rd at 2PM ET.
The Verge contacted YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Meta, Rumble, and Kick to ask if they plan to allow the livestream to be aired on their platforms. None responded before publication.

title: Anthropic launches free AI security scans for open-source projects
summary: Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free service providing automated security vulnerability scanning for open-source projects using its advanced AI models. The fully model-generated reports offer faster and more frequent scans but lack human review, potentially resulting in false positives.
content:
Anthropic's offering to help open-source projects track down security vulnerabilities with a new service called OSS Scanner. It says open-source projects that opt-in will get "thorough, periodic security scans by our strongest models at no cost." That could mean open-source projects get alerted about possible security issues sooner, but the trade-off is that OSS Scanner's reports don't come with human review:
The outputs of this opt-in vulnerability scanner will be fully model-generated, without human review or triage. This will enable faster and more frequent scanning, but means that it is possible reports will be incorrect or invalid. Th …

title: SpaceX announces plan to become a ‘major mobile carrier’
summary: SpaceX has acquired low-band spectrum licenses as part of its plan to establish Starlink Mobile as a major U.S. mobile carrier, combining satellite and terrestrial networks. The 800 MHz spectrum will enable signal penetration through buildings, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon.
content:
SpaceX has acquired a portfolio of low-band spectrum licenses - a move the company says "will pave the way" for its Starlink Mobile service to become a "major" US carrier. When the Federal Communications Commission signs off on the deal, SpaceX says it will deploy its new architecture that combines its satellite-to-mobile constellation with a terrestrial mobile network, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon.
The licenses include up to 14 megahertz of paired spectrum in the 800 MHz band, which SpaceX says will allow Starlink Mobile's signal to penetrate through walls and buildings. SpaceX previously acquired 2GHz spectrum from  …

title: AMD will bring FSR 4 to handhelds by the end of 2026
summary: AMD has committed to bringing its framerate-enhancing FSR 4 technology to handhelds by the end of 2026, though it remains unclear if existing devices like the Steam Deck will receive it. The rollout will coincide with a new AMD chip designed to support FSR4 capabilities.
content:
It's already possible to get AMD's framerate-enhancing FSR 4 boost on handhelds as old as the Steam Deck - but in June, AMD reserved the right to disappoint handheld gamers by not officially bringing FSR 4 to older handhelds. Now, AMD consumer chip boss Jack Huynh says he will bring the tech to some handhelds by the end of the year.
Which handhelds? It's still not clear if it will come to existing handhelds, or if you'll need a new one to get it - because it comes alongside news that AMD is releasing a new FSR4-capable chip.
"We will expand the machine learning AI-based FSR4 technology, which was first introduced to existing external graph …

Rek says it is the "the humanoid robot fighting league" on its website, and the robot appears to be one from EngineAI but with a Terminator-like head swapped on top.

summary: Four men detained at the Folkston ICE Processing Center in Georgia used the facility's video conferencing system to expose conditions inside and what they describe as an intentionally dysfunctional legal system. The activists documented concerns about indefinite detention in privately owned facilities that profit from detainee confinement.
content:
Detainees are seen in a yard at the Folkston ICE Processing Center on September 9, 2025, in Folkston, Georgia. (Photo by ELIJAH NOUVELAGE/AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images	

Four men detained at an ICE detention center in rural Georgia used the facility's video conferencing software to expose both the conditions inside and President Donald Trump's hostile takeover of the immigration courts. In the five-minute video, the men describe an intentionally dysfunctional legal system designed to keep them trapped in federal custody for months or years - in privately owned facilities that profit from their confinement.

title: Tim Cook says ‘I’m not meddling’ in the new Apple CEO’s business

Cook's still a visible representative of the company, having been recently photographed attending a state dinner at the White House. But in an interview with The Independent, Cook says he's "not meddling" in Ternus' work.

title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
summary: Anthropic updated its usage policy to explicitly prohibit extreme, repeated abuse of Claude while preserving allowances for ordinary criticism and frustration. The policy also addresses election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons development, and surveillance.
content: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

zh.title: Anthropic更新使用政策以禁止模型滥用和选举干扰
zh.summary: Anthropic更新了其使用政策，明确禁止对Claude的极端、反复滥用，同时保留对普通批评和挫折的宽容。该政策还涉及选举干扰、欺骗性活动、武器开发和监视。

title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
summary: OpenAI's recent mathematical proofs have deviated from guidelines established by mathematical researchers who consulted with the lab. The findings suggest OpenAI's math capabilities still fall short of professional mathematical standards.
content: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.

zh.title: OpenAI的数学解决方案还未达到该领域的标准
zh.summary: OpenAI最近的数学证明偏离了与该实验室合作的数学研究人员建立的指南。研究结果表明OpenAI的数学能力仍然不符合专业数学标准。

title: A startup founder who served time in prison is looking to court an untapped market: ex-cons
summary: Richard Bronson, a former Stratton Oakmont partner and ex-convict, launched Commissary Club, an AI-powered startup helping recently released prisoners find employment, housing, community, and relationships. The venture targets the underserved population of formerly incarcerated individuals.
content: Richard Bronson, a former Stratton Oakmont partner who served time in federal prison for securities violations, has launched Commissary Club, a startup that uses AI to help people leaving prison find jobs, housing, community, and even dates.

zh.title: 曾入狱的初创公司创始人寻求开拓一个未开发的市场：前罪犯
zh.summary: 曾是Stratton Oakmont合伙人的前罪犯Richard Bronson推出了Commissary Club，这是一个由AI驱动的初创公司，帮助最近获释的囚犯寻找就业、住房、社区和人际关系。该企业针对被忽视的已释放个人群体。

title: Amazon's new Alexa Tablets drop the Fire branding but are more Android than ever
summary: Amazon has discontinued the Fire branding for its tablet line and integrated Google Play as its app store, making the tablets more Android-native. The shift reflects Amazon's strategic pivot in its tablet hardware strategy.
content: Amazon killed its app store, so Google Play it is.

zh.title: 亚马逊新Alexa平板电脑放弃Fire品牌，更多Android特性
zh.summary: 亚马逊已停用其平板电脑系列的Fire品牌，并将Google Play整合为其应用商店，使平板电脑更具Android本地特性。这一转变反映了亚马逊在平板电脑硬件策略中的战略调整。

title: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
summary: Natura has launched the Interface smart ring priced at $99, enabling users to summon AI agents for task completion, thought capture, and device control while serving as a health tracker. The wearable represents a new form factor for AI assistant interaction.
content: Natura’s $99 Interface smart ring lets you summon AI agents with the press of a finger to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices — while doubling as a health tracker.

zh.title: Natura 推出 99 美元智能戒指，将 AI 代理带到你的手指上
zh.summary: Natura 推出了价格为 99 美元的 Interface 智能戒指，使用户能够召唤 AI 代理来完成任务、捕获想法和控制设备，同时充当健康追踪器。这款可穿戴设备代表了与 AI 助手交互的新形态。

title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
summary: Goodfire has developed a cost-effective monitoring solution that inspects AI model operations internally rather than using a second AI system to oversee agent behavior. The approach promises to detect anomalies and problematic behavior at lower cost.
content: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.

zh.title: Goodfire 表示其新型"由内向外"监视器以极低成本检测恶意 AI 代理
zh.summary: Goodfire 开发了一种经济高效的监控解决方案，该方案从内部检查 AI 模型操作，而不是使用第二个 AI 系统来监督代理行为。这种方法承诺以更低成本检测异常和有问题的行为。

title: US bars Microsoft, Adobe, and major IT firms from green card program for skilled foreign workers
summary: The U.S. government has suspended Microsoft, Adobe, and major Indian IT firms including Infosys, TCS, Wipro, and HCL from the H-1B visa green card program for skilled foreign workers. The suspension represents a significant policy shift affecting tech industry hiring practices.
content: The other firms being suspended from the program include Capgemini, Cognizant, HCL, Infosys, Tata, and Wipro.

zh.title: 美国禁止微软、Adobe 和主要 IT 公司参与技术移民绿卡项目
zh.summary: 美国政府已暂停微软、Adobe 和包括 Infosys、TCS、Wipro 和 HCL 在内的主要印度 IT 公司参加 H-1B 签证绿卡项目。这一暂停代表了影响科技行业招聘实践的重大政策转变。

title: Amazon builds 1,000th satellite, will launch space internet service by end of year
summary: Amazon has completed construction of its 1,000th satellite for Project Kuiper and plans to begin offering satellite internet service by year's end. The achievement marks a major milestone in Amazon's bid to compete with Starlink's space-based internet offering.
content: "If this was easy, everybody else would be doing it."

zh.title: 亚马逊完成第1000颗卫星建造，将于年底前推出卫星互联网服务
zh.summary: 亚马逊已完成其Kuiper项目的第1000颗卫星建造，并计划于年底前开始提供卫星互联网服务。这一成就是亚马逊与Starlink争夺太空互联网市场的重要里程碑。

title: Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls
summary: Elon Musk publicly questioned India's business environment after Starlink's satellite internet service launch has been delayed in the country. The criticism suggests geopolitical and regulatory obstacles to Starlink's expansion in India.
content: “Is Ambani the real boss of India?” Elon Musk asked as he questioned why Starlink has yet to launch its satellite internet service in the country.

zh.title: 随着Starlink印度服务推迟，埃隆·马斯克质疑安巴尼的影响力
zh.summary: 在Starlink卫星互联网服务在印度推迟后，埃隆·马斯克公开质疑印度的商业环境。这一批评表明Starlink在印度扩展面临地缘政治和监管障碍。

title: New York alleges TikTok gave teens, children a placebo safety feature instead of a real one
summary: New York has filed a lawsuit claiming TikTok implemented a fake safety feature for teens and children rather than providing genuine protection. The case is part of a broader multi-state effort to hold TikTok accountable for allegedly designing its platform to encourage addictive use.
content: New York’s lawsuit against the company is one of more than two dozen cases brought by states accusing the social media giant of designing its platform to encourage addictive use among children.

zh.title: 纽约指控TikTok向青少年儿童提供虚假安全功能而非真正保护
zh.summary: 纽约提起诉讼，指控TikTok为青少年儿童实施虚假安全功能，而非提供真正保护。该诉讼是多州联合努力对TikTok问责的一部分，声称其故意设计平台以鼓励成瘾使用。

title: Asos confirms breach of customer data after hackers send rogue app notification
summary: Asos has confirmed a security breach of customer data after attackers sent unauthorized push notifications claiming to have compromised the company's cloud storage. The incident highlights vulnerabilities in the fashion retailer's security infrastructure.
content: The hackers alerted the fashion giant's customers through a push notification that said they had "fully compromised" the company's cloud storage.

zh.title: Asos确认客户数据泄露 黑客发送恶意应用通知
zh.summary: Asos在攻击者发送未经授权的推送通知声称已入侵该公司云存储后，确认了客户数据安全漏洞。该事件凸显了这家时尚零售商安全基础设施中的漏洞。

title: Hear from Ambrosia Energy and Bloom Energy execs on where the AI infrastructure boom is creating opportunity at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: Energy infrastructure executives from Ambrosia Energy and Bloom Energy will discuss AI-driven opportunities at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. The panel reflects growing interest in the intersection of AI infrastructure and energy systems.
content: Ambrosia Energy CEO Ben Longmier and Bloom Energy SVP Bill Thayer join the Smart Systems Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt. Register now to save up to $100. Grab a second of the same pass to save 50%.

zh.title: 在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026大会上聆听Ambrosia Energy和Bloom Energy高管讨论AI基础设施繁荣带来的机会
zh.summary: Ambrosia Energy和Bloom Energy的能源基础设施高管将在TechCrunch Disrupt 2026讨论AI驱动的机遇。该论坛反映了人们对AI基础设施与能源系统交汇点的日益增长的兴趣。

title: Spotify is getting more serious about selling enterprise software
summary: Spotify has launched technology.spotify.com to make its internal software technology available to external enterprise customers. The move signals Spotify's expansion into the B2B software business.
content: The company launched technology.spotify.com, a new site that will make its internal tech available to outsiders.

zh.title: Spotify开始更认真地销售企业软件
zh.summary: Spotify推出了technology.spotify.com网站，将其内部软件技术提供给外部企业客户。此举标志着Spotify进入B2B软件业务的扩展。

title: Uber and China’s Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London
summary: Uber and China's Pony.ai plan to begin testing autonomous Gen-7 robotaxis in London within weeks, marking an expansion of self-driving taxi services into a major European market.
content: The two companies said on Thursday that they would begin testing Pony.ai's Gen-7 robotaxis in London in the coming weeks.

zh.title: 优步和中国Pony.ai计划在伦敦推出无人驾驶出租车
zh.summary: 优步和中国Pony.ai计划在数周内在伦敦开始测试自动驾驶第7代无人驾驶出租车,标志着自动驾驶出租车服务扩展到欧洲主要市场。

title: Xbox is launching a new film and TV division
summary: Xbox creates a new centralized division called XP to consolidate entertainment ventures beyond gaming, including film, television, consumer products, and creator partnerships.
content:
Jack Black in A Minecraft Movie. | Image: Warner Bros.	

Xbox is launching a new division, called "XP," that's dedicated to Xbox experiences that aren't video games, including films and TV adaptations, consumer products, live events, and partnerships with creators and brands. Different teams at Xbox already do this work, but it will all now fall under the centralized XP division.
XP formalizes four "investment areas," according to a blog post by Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball:
XBOX PICTURES: Bringing our worlds and characters to new audiences through film, television, and other forms of linear storytelling.  
XBOX PRODUCTS: Creating products that are authentic to the fandom that al …

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Xbox推出新的电影和电视部门
zh.summary: Xbox创建了一个新的集中式部门XP,以整合游戏之外的娱乐事业,包括电影、电视、消费产品和创作者合作伙伴关系。

title: Vesta raises $30M to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders
summary: AI-native mortgage software startup Vesta raised $30 million in Series funding to expand its agent-based platform that automates loan origination for lenders.
content: Vesta, an AI-native software startup that helps lenders originate mortgages, announced a $30 million round led by Conversion Capital.

zh.title: Vesta融资3000万美元为抵押贷款出借人引入AI代理人群集
zh.summary: AI原生抵押贷款软件初创公司Vesta融资3000万美元,以扩展其基于代理人的平台,该平台可自动化贷款人的贷款发起流程。

title: Cupertino might be made for your mom, but it’s a good take on tech
summary: CBS launches drama series Cupertino that uses contemporary tech controversies as storytelling backdrop, translating tech industry backlash into broadcast television drama.
content:
Ella Stiller, Mike Colter, and Rachel Keller star in Cupertino. | CBS	

Cupertino brings the tech backlash to the CBS procedural - an initially awkward combination, but with rewarding results. The show starts off just slightly unsure, but quickly figures out what to do with these strange times, creating fictionalized dupes of the Zizians, Polymarket, Jeff Bezos' looksmaxxing obsession, OpenAI stealing Scarlett Johansson's voice, and the fight for AI guardrails, among other familiar tales, and using them to speak to the feeling of helplessness in the face of rapid change that extends well beyond the greater San Francisco area. It turns out the seemingly outdated tools of broadcast TV are a fantastic way to tackle …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 《库比蒂诺》可能是为你妈妈打造的，但它对科技的诠释很不错
zh.summary: CBS推出剧集《库比蒂诺》，以当代科技争议为故事背景，将科技行业的抵触转化为广播电视剧。

title: Nvidia's big bet on physical AI aims for safer robotaxis, humanoid robots
summary: Nvidia advances its physical AI safety suite to support robotics companies building autonomous systems, including robotaxis and humanoid robots.
content: Full-stack safety solution for physical AI is being used by robotics companies.

zh.title: 英伟达对物理AI的重大押注瞄准更安全的自动驾驶出租车和人形机器人

title: A senator tried to ban gambling on prediction markets—now she's a Kalshi lobbyist
summary: Senator Blanche Lincoln, who authored legislation restricting sports betting, now works as a lobbyist for Kalshi prediction market platform—a shift highlighting changing regulatory perspectives.
content: Sen. Blanche Lincoln wrote law that let US ban sports-event contracts. She lobbies for the other side now.

zh.title: 这位参议员曾试图禁止预测市场赌博，如今却成为Kalshi的游说者
zh.summary: 曾撰写限制体育博彩立法的参议员布兰奇·林肯，现为Kalshi预测市场平台担任游说者——这一转变突出了监管观点的改变。

title: India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch
summary: India's government disputes Elon Musk's discrimination claims against Starlink, stating the company is simply awaiting routine security clearance for commercial operations.
content: Starlink is still awaiting security clearance before it can seek spectrum and begin commercial services in India.

zh.title: 印度驳斥埃隆·马斯克关于Starlink启动差别对待的指控
zh.summary: 印度政府反驳了埃隆·马斯克对Starlink的差别对待指控，称该公司只是在等待商业运营的例行安全审查。

title: Microsoft event debuts new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes
summary: Microsoft unveiled new AI-focused hardware and Windows updates at its annual event, positioning AI as central to the company's future direction.
content: Get ready for more AI in your Windows and more AI on the desktop.

zh.title: 微软发布会推出新型AI友好硬件和Windows更新
zh.summary: 微软在年度发布会上推出了新型AI硬件和Windows更新，将AI定位为公司未来发展的核心。
